verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs confirm that security scans run automatically in CI/CD pipelines when merge requests are created, and that findings appear in the MR with inline annotations on changed lines. Nothing in the pack shows the pipeline failing on new findings via exit codes. Secret push protection blocking a push is a separate pre-receive control, not a CI build gate, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented build-failure or exit-code behavior on new findings, a new-versus-existing finding gating policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run scans in CI on every pull request and fail the build on new findings via exit codes

citations.quote: scans run automatically as part of CI/CD pipelines when code is committed or merge requests are created
Security findings appear directly in merge requests and IDEs, notifying developers before code is merged.
Merge request changes view: Shows inline annotations for changed lines.
